data.question: Can your tableware be used in a dishwasher/microwave?
data.answer: Yes, except for items that have gold or silver detailing.

data.question: Where can I see your tableware?
data.answer: You can visit our showroom or partner stores listed on the contact page.

data.question: Do you offer gift certificates?
data.answer: Yes, we offer physical and digital gift certificates in various denominations.

data.question: Is there a loyalty program?
data.answer: Yes, our members get exclusive offers.

data.question: Which regions do you deliver to?
data.answer: We deliver nationwide as well as internationally to selected countries.

data.question: What is the delivery cost?
data.answer: Delivery cost depends on the destination and total order weight, calculated at checkout.
